name: Ashley Branagh
source:
Coming from a broken home, her parents divorced early in her life, Ashley found solace in music. Her rock, punk and metal albums lining the wall of her room, she embraced the style and rocks a metal/punk girl style. Music was especially important because her father is a musician and Ash is a big fan. However, her isolation means she often relies only on herself while her father is away, even if it's to her detriment. She likes to tease others and often is found flirting with the Headmaster. She loves the beach and wishes that her parents can make up and find the time to take her to see the ocean.

Her favorite band is Rage Against the Machine
Her favorite food is Spaghetti
